changelog: **Setting readers moved onto the one accessor (#1621):** every `getSetting()` / `getSettings()` call site in `src/` now reads through `src/lib/settingsResolver.ts` — `resolveSettingRaw(key, { orgId })` where a rule module parses the string (identical semantics, now cached per request/job), typed `resolveSetting()` for the plain booleans/enums (`blindReview`, `outcomeAutoSend`, `selfRegistration`, `autoAdvanceOnOfferAccept`). The programme layer now takes effect: `reminderDays` resolves per relation's programme in the mentor attention queue, the stale-contact reminder sweep (resolved inside the loop under `withSettingsCache`) and the relation-health reader shared by the nightly sweep, the admin monitor and the programme scorecard; `outcomeAutoSend` per relation's programme. New CI guard `npm run check:settings-accessor` fails on a direct `prisma.setting` read outside the settings modules and on any new legacy reader; `src/lib/retention.ts` (client-reachable) is the one pinned pending entry. `e2e/settings-accessor-scopes.spec.ts` pins two programmes nudging on their own cadence and a cross-tenant sweep reading each tenant's value.
